name: cost-router
description: Cache-aware model and effort routing for the main chat and every subagent, a shared budget, evidence-labelled context thresholds, and verified automatic handoffs to a fresh context.

budgetUsd.title: Task budget (USD, estimate)
budgetUsd.description: Hard limit per task at API list prices, shared by the main chat, every subagent, planner, handoff and check calls. Past it new prompts and agents are refused. 0 = no limit. Not a measure of subscription allowance.

budgetSpent.title: When the budget is spent
budgetSpent.description: handoff: save a verified handoff, clear the context and continue in a fresh chat with a new budget. stop: refuse new prompts and agents until the budget is raised or /router reset.

softBudgetPct.title: Soft budget (%)
softBudgetPct.description: Past this share of the budget the router stops moving routes up a model and warns once.

mainModel.title: Main chat model
mainModel.description: keep: the session's model stays (effort is routed; a stronger model only when checks keep failing). route: the main chat's model is routed too, behind the cost gate.

tiers.title: Model tiers
tiers.description: Comma-separated model ids, cheapest first. Subagents are routed across them; the first three map to light, standard and hard work.

effortCap.title: Highest reasoning effort
effortCap.description: The highest effort the router may use. Lower tiers climb only to high before the next model is tried.

fable.title: Fable for tasks too hard for the tiers
fable.description: When the strongest configured route still fails (checks keep failing at the top, or you say the last answer was wrong), ask: ask once per task whether to switch to the Fable model; auto: switch without asking; off: never. Never past the soft budget.

fableModel.title: Fable model id
fableModel.description: The model the setting above switches to.

pinModel.title: Pin main chat model
pinModel.description: A model id that always runs the main chat (subagents are still routed). Empty = automatic.

switchMarginPct.title: Switch margin (%)
switchMarginPct.description: A cost-driven change (model, effort, delegation, cost handoff) must save more than its overhead (cache rebuild, planning, agent startup, verification, retry risk, handoff) by this much.

minSwitchUsd.title: Minimum benefit (USD)
minSwitchUsd.description: A cost-driven change must also save at least this much, net.

switchCooldownTurns.title: Switch cooldown (turns)
switchCooldownTurns.description: Main-chat turns after a route change before another cost-driven change. Quality-driven escalation is not held back.

retryRiskPct.title: Retry risk (% per tier down)
retryRiskPct.description: Heuristic: the share of the work expected to be redone per capability tier a cheaper route drops. Counted as overhead of the cheaper route.

pricesJson.title: Price overrides (JSON)
pricesJson.description: Merged over the built-in table, $/MTok: {"model-id": {"in": 2, "out": 10, "read": 0.2, "write": 2.5}}. Empty = built-in prices.

planner.title: Plan long tasks
planner.description: Ask the cheapest model to break long or multi-step tasks into subtasks before the turn.

plannerMinChars.title: Planner threshold (characters)
plannerMinChars.description: Prompts shorter than this (and not a multi-step list) are routed by the free heuristic alone and kept whole.

agentOverheadTokens.title: Subagent startup (tokens)
agentOverheadTokens.description: The fixed context a new subagent writes before working: part of the overhead a delegation must beat.

maxConcurrentAgents.title: Max concurrent agents
maxConcurrentAgents.description: Agents running at once, at every depth together.

maxDepth.title: Max nesting depth
maxDepth.description: 1 = only the main chat may spawn agents; 2 = those agents may spawn one more level.

escalateAfterErrors.title: Escalate after failures
escalateAfterErrors.description: Failure points before a loop moves up (effort first, then the next model at the same effort). A failed test or build counts 2, another failed tool call 1; a passing check resets.

handoff.title: Automatic handoff
handoff.description: Between turns, past a threshold, save a verified handoff, clear the context and continue the task automatically.

handoffContextPct.title: Handoff at context (%)
handoffContextPct.description: Context-window share that triggers a quality-driven handoff when no threshold below applies. 60 is an unvalidated fallback, not a measured degradation point. 0 = off.

handoffContextTokens.title: Handoff at context (tokens)
handoffContextTokens.description: Absolute context size that triggers a quality-driven handoff when no threshold below applies. 0 = off.

thresholdsJson.title: Thresholds per model and task (JSON)
thresholdsJson.description: Overrides by key: "model:kind", "model", "*:kind" or "default"; kind is light, standard or hard. {"claude-haiku-5-5:hard": {"pct": 40, "tokens": 150000, "source": "my eval 2026-11"}}. Empty = the two settings above.

headroomTokens.title: Reserve (tokens)
headroomTokens.description: Room kept below the context limit (or Claude Code's auto-compaction point) for the next operation and a complete handoff.

signalsForHandoff.title: Warning signals for an early handoff
signalsForHandoff.description: Repeated failed commands, rereads of unchanged files and repeated user instructions are signals, not proof: this many, at 75% of the threshold, bring a handoff forward. 0 = never.

handoffCostUsd.title: Cost handoff at chat spend (USD)
handoffCostUsd.description: Spend in the current chat that proposes a cost-driven handoff; it runs only if its estimated saving beats its overhead by the margin. 0 = off.

expectedRemainingSteps.title: Expected remaining requests
expectedRemainingSteps.description: How many more main-chat requests a cost-driven handoff's saving is counted over.
